approved_color: preserve existing live pure-ground adaptation shader and its strength; only contact layout changes

surface_plans.grass:
GRASS surface, NO fallen leaves, loose soil clods or pebbles. Grass low, subdued, no yellow neon. Bare magenta gaps between individual blades; the grass grows out of ground and overlaps ONLY local root/stone edge.
1 tree thin: ONE broken short wispy cluster in the FRONT root cleft, slightly left of trunk center; both far side edges remain bare. No second tuft.
2 old broad tree: a thin interrupted run of3or4 short grass tips hugs the BACK-LEFT root fold, no bulky tuft; exposed front roots and right edge stay clear.
3 forked tree: ONE sparse unequal group of2 short blades in RIGHT rear crease, no matching left group; a tiny low tip can tuck under front root.
4 flat stone: only2 very short blades in a LEFT crack, broad front and right edge clean.
5 stocky stone: one modest bent blade at FRONT-RIGHT corner with tiny partly buried tip beside it, all other edge bare.
6 wedge: a sparse low run of2or3 tiny clipped grass tips under FRONT-LEFT third, no right-end grass.
7 joined rock: tiny low growth INSIDE the central base hollow between the two lobes, both outer ends clean.
8 narrow high stone: NO grass tuft at all; clean slightly irregular embedded lower edge, not standing on a base.
9 chipped stone:3 tiny uneven low blades across the FRONT-CENTER biased left, one shorter than others, no tuft on outer corners.
surface_plans.forest:
FOREST floor contact. Subdued sparse grass and optional brown fragments, NOT every object has leaves. No repeated whole oval leaves sitting like decorations. No soil/leaf ring. Dark quiet contact detail, not bright orange. Objects must look embedded, not standing on leaf bouquets.
1 tree thin: one small HALF-BURIED broken leaf in FRONT-LEFT root cleft and2 short low grass tips near same cleft; opposite edge bare.
2 old broad tree: three tiny UNEQUAL leaf fragments caught BEHIND one large BACK-LEFT root; a very small sliver can show in front-center crease; no matched right-side leaf. Mostly exposed roots.
3 forked tree: NO visible fallen leaves. Only2 understated short grass tips in RIGHT-REAR crease, left/front root bare.
4 flat stone: NO leaf; just one short grass filament behind LEFT lip, front edge clear.
5 stocky stone: ONE small torn diagonal leaf partly tucked under FRONT-CENTER-RIGHT, no opposite leaf or tuft.
6 wedge: two minuscule dark litter fragments under LOW LEFT corner; right side entirely bare, no ornamental leaf silhouette.
7 joined rock: ONE tiny partly concealed leaf fragment in central base hollow, no outer decorations.
8 narrow high stone: NO visible leaves or grass, only natural embedded contour. Do not force a decoration.
9 chipped stone: ONE partly hidden small dry leaf at REAR-RIGHT notch, FRONT edge bare, no partner on left.
surface_plans.dirt:
BARE EARTH contact, NO green grass, NO fallen leaves, NO loose orange pebbles/clods, NO small rocks placed around base. Earth has muted grey-brown ground palette, much lower contrast than trunk. Show small thin OCCLUDING SOIL EDGES attached to actual contacts, never independent decorative chunks or paired mounds.
1 tree thin: roots enter earth with one shallow thin soil slit over FRONT-LEFT root cleft; both outer root edges have no extra soil chunks.
2 old broad tree: one thin irregular earth edge along BACK-LEFT root only, no corresponding right mound; front root ends partially buried directly.
3 forked tree: tiny low soil overlap at FRONT-CENTER slightly right, other roots bare; no side beads.
4 flat stone: low irregular soil overlap on FRONT-LEFT edge only, rest directly meets ground; no loose clods.
5 stocky stone: plain embedded lower contour, NO extra soil mound or decorative clods at all.
6 wedge: a very short narrow soil lip beneath LOW LEFT corner; right side clean; no orange bead.
7 joined rock: soil shows only in CENTRAL base indentation, not two outer corners.
8 narrow high stone: only a subtle back-left buried notch; no grass/leaf/clod on either side.
9 chipped stone: one uneven thin earth edge partially covers chipped FRONT-RIGHT corner, all other bottom contacts direct; no left-right pair.

scope: 9 selected identities x3 local contact layouts; original upper art retained
